sloka: वानरा यदि वः खेदः प्रनष्टः फल भक्षणात् ।यदि च एतत् मया श्राव्यम् श्रोतुम् इच्छामि कथताम् ॥४-५२-२॥
transliteration: vānarā yadi vaḥ khedaḥ pranaṣṭaḥ phala bhakṣaṇāt ।yadi ca etat mayā śrāvyam śrotum icchāmi kathatām ॥4-52-2॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys if you have been relieved of your fatigue after eating fruits, now tell me about yourself, if you think it can be told. I want to hear.
translations.hindi: दे धर्मचारिणी ! हम सब तेरे शरण हैँ। महात्मा सुम्रीब ने हमारे लिए जो अवधि बाँध दी थी
